# Warraich Goods Transport Company (وڑائچ گڈز ٹرانسپورٹ کمپنی)

> Full Truckload (FTL) commercial goods transport, home shifting, and office relocation across Pakistan — serving since 2008 from Samundri, District Faisalabad.

## Company Identity & Credentials
- **Business Name:** Warraich Goods Transport Company (وڑائچ گڈز ٹرانسپورٹ کمپنی)

## Core Service Policy
- **Dedicated Full Truckload (FTL) Only:** We book whole vehicles exclusively for one customer per trip. We do not mix loose parcels or small packages.
- **Documentation & Protection:** Written official bilty receipt, computerized weighbridge scale slips, signed Proof of Delivery (POD), and double waterproof PVC tarpaulins on every trip.

## Truck Fleet
1. **Shahzore Commercial Pickup (1 - 3.5 Tons | 10-12 ft):** Local and inter-city urgent loads, 1-2 room home shifting, agricultural bags, shop stock.
2. **Mazda 6-Wheeler Freight Truck (4 - 10 Tons | 14-18 ft):** Factory raw materials, textile yarn/fabric, wheat/corn/cotton, full household moves.
3. **Sample Extended Chassis Truck (8 - 16 Tons | 18-22 ft):** High-volume bulky factory cartons, chemical drums, cotton bales, poultry feed, cement bags.
4. **Bedford Heavy Long Haul Hauler (15 - 28+ Tons | 22-28+ ft):** Heavy machinery, steel girders, construction material, Karachi Port long-haul routes.
